## Overview

`data/data_model_dasch.json` defines the DSP project `sgb` (shortcode `4001`) and the `SGB` ontology.
The file uses the [dsp-tools](https://docs.dasch.swiss/latest/DSP-TOOLS/) project format.
The file must agree with the ontology on the DSP server.

```{mermaid}
graph TD
  parent[Parent] --- image[Image]
  parent --- document[Document]
  parent --- text[Text]
  parent --- without[ResourceWithoutMedia]
```

Each media record links to its `Parent` with `linkToParentObject`.

## Resource classes

| Class                  | DSP superclass             | Content                                                  |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Parent`               | `Resource`                 | An Omeka item. It holds the media records.               |
| `Image`                | `StillImageRepresentation` | An image file: TIFF, JPEG, PNG, or GIF.                  |
| `Document`             | `DocumentRepresentation`   | A PDF file.                                              |
| `Text`                 | `TextRepresentation`       | A text or data file: CSV, TXT, Markdown, JSON, or GeoJSON. |
| `ResourceWithoutMedia` | `Resource`                 | Metadata only: a private file, a placeholder, or an unknown format. |

DSP v40 does not accept CSV as a document file. Thus text and data files go to `Text`, which keeps the file unchanged.

## Lists

| List       | DSP label                    | Values                                              |
| ---------- | ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `language` | ISO 639-1                    | Two-letter language codes, for example `de`.       |
| `type`     | DCMI Type                    | DCMI types, for example `Image` and `Dataset`.     |
| `license`  | Licenses                     | License URLs, for example CC BY 4.0.                |
| `temporal` | Stadt.Geschichte.Basel Epoche | Periods, for example `Frühe Neuzeit`.              |
| `format`   | Internet Media Type          | Media types, for example `image/tiff`.             |

The list lookup ignores case. If a label has no list node, sync keeps the DSP value.

SGB stopped assigning subjects. Subjects are discontinued, not deferred.
SGB first used the OpenGender Schlagwortindex manually.
The Digitalausschuss found its coverage too limited.
It found its focus too narrow for the heterogeneous material.
No workable alternative exists.
The [Iconclass VLM experiment](https://github.com/Stadt-Geschichte-Basel/iconclass-classification) was not successful.
Thus the data model has no subject list and no `hasSubjectList` property.

## Mapping table

`FIELDS` in `src/omeka2dsp/fields.py` holds one row for each DSP property. The payloads and the sync both read it.
A test makes sure that this table and `FIELDS` agree.

| DSP property         | Omeka term            | Kind              | Classes |
| -------------------- | --------------------- | ----------------- | ------- |
| `hasIdentifier` | `dcterms:identifier` | text, create only | all |
| `hasTitle` | `dcterms:title` | text | all |
| `hasDescription` | `dcterms:description` | text | all |
| `hasTemporalList` | `dcterms:temporal` | list | all |
| `hasLanguageList` | `dcterms:language` | list | all |
| `isPartOf` | `dcterms:isPartOf` | rich text | Parent |
| `hasCreator` | `dcterms:creator` | rich text | media |
| `hasPublisher` | `dcterms:publisher` | rich text | media |
| `hasSource` | `dcterms:source` | rich text | media |
| `hasRelation` | `dcterms:relation` | rich text | media |
| `hasDate` | `dcterms:date` | text | media |
| `hasExtent` | `dcterms:extent` | text | media |
| `hasRights` | `dcterms:rights` | text | media |
| `hasAbstract` | `dcterms:abstract` | text | media |
| `hasTypeList` | `dcterms:type` | list, many | media |
| `hasFormatList` | `dcterms:format` | list | media |
| `hasLicenseList` | `dcterms:license` | list | media |
| `linkToParentObject` | (parent IRI) | link, create only | media |

- "media" means `Image`, `Document`, `Text`, and `ResourceWithoutMedia`.
- A "text" field takes the first literal value of the term.
- A "rich text" field gets one `TextValue` for each Omeka value. A URI value becomes a standoff link with its label.
- A "list" field takes the first literal value and finds its list node. A "many" field takes all labels.
- "create only" means that sync writes the value when it creates the record and does not change it later.
- `hasAbstract` writes ";" as "&#59". This keeps the abstracts that are already on DSP unchanged.

## File permissions

A private media keeps public metadata.
Only project members can see its file: `CR knora-admin:ProjectAdmin|D knora-admin:ProjectMember`.
